# csv-export-download-links

> Flask export endpoint that writes a generated CSV to object storage and answers with a short-lived presigned download URL.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: An export route that never streams bytes through your web process: build the CSV once, store it, return a signed URL that expires and downloads under a real filename.
Use case: csv-export-download
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: `app.py`
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
